title: Descent of a monic fraction-field divisor over a normal domain
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], let $K=\operatorname{Frac}(A)$, and let $F\in A[T]$ and $G\in K[T]$ be monic polynomials [def-weil-polynomial-ring], meaning their leading coefficients are $1$. Write $F_K$ for the coefficientwise image of $F$ under the canonical inclusion $A\hookrightarrow K$. If $G\mid F_K$ in $K[T]$, meaning $F_K=GQ$ for some $Q\in K[T]$, then there exists $H\in A[T]$ whose coefficientwise image in $K[T]$ is $G$. No Noetherian or unique factorization hypothesis on $A$ is assumed.
